name: Lake Eppalock
role: Holds the Campaspe and Coliban. When full, inflows spill straight down the river to Rochester.

name: Malmsbury Reservoir
role: Coliban River, last storage before Eppalock

name: Goulburn Weir
role: Diverts Goulburn water to Waranga Basin

name: Waranga Basin
role: Supplies the Waranga Western Channel, which crosses the Campaspe at Rochester

name: Dartmouth Dam
role: Mitta Mitta River, releases into Lake Hume
